name: New York Slice
summary: I-cut-you-choose pizza drafting game where players collect or eat slices to win majority bonuses and pepperoni points.
rules_text: Shuffle pizza slices into face-down stacks of 11, each topped with a face-down Special. Each round one player is Slicer: reveal the Special and lay the 11 slices face-up in a random circular order. The Slicer cuts the circle into a number of contiguous portions equal to player count, each containing at least one slice or the Special; the order cannot be changed. The Special may be attached to a portion or be its own portion. Players in clockwise order from Slicer's left pick one portion, Slicer last. When taking slices, you may collect them face-up in front of you for majority scoring, or if a slice has pepperoni you may instead eat it face-down for 1 point per pepperoni. Anchovies on collected slices are negative. After all stacks are used, score: each pizza type awards its printed value to the player with the most collected slices of that type, ties give no points. Add Special bonuses, then eaten pepperoni minus collected anchovies. Highest total wins.
